thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: high error rate observed on canary pool 'eu-west-2/canary-v2' - 5xx rate 12%, latency p95 1.8s (baseline 0.4s). Pager: #eng-oncall. link: https://metrics.redwood/in/INC-2750004

alice: acked. i'm oncall, looking now.

alice: can someone confirm what changed in this rollout? rollout id abc123

raj: that's canary rollout abc123. we enabled kernel-quant optimizations + new routing policy (route_v2) and bumped canary to 10% traffic ~ 10m ago.

maria: seeing same in the runtime logs - a lot of kv_cache_eviction and "alloc failed" traces, looks like memory pressure on the new kernel path.

alice: any customer-facing errors / scope?

raj: yes. CS reported errors from a handful of EU tenants. SLO alerting triggered. approx 2.3k requests/min affected. customer ticket CR-1248 opened.

alice: ok flip the canary flag off and roll back variant. @maria please kill the route_v2 canary flag first.

maria: executing: ```rolloutctl feature-flag set route_v2_canary false --reason "canary 5xx spike" --by maria``` :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Feature flag route_v2_canary set to false by maria at 2750004342

alice: good. raj, start the safe rollback to stable variant (v1). prefer graceful draining so we avoid more 5xx.

raj: running: ```redwoodctl rollout rollback --rollout-id abc123 --target-variant v1 --force --reason "canary instability"``` -> started

deploy-bot: Rollback started for rollout abc123. progress: 0% -> 35% -> 100% at 2750004389

alice: quick check on metrics: 5xx down to 0.7% in canary pool, latency p95 back to ~0.45s. errors trending to baseline.

kevin: CC'ing CS team. updating CR-1248 with timeline and mitigation steps, contacting top impacted accounts now. assigned: kevin.

alice: preparing handoff: i'll stay on the thread for another 15m. @raj stay for monitoring until 2750004600. next oncall for escalation ops: kevin will own customer comms.

raj: ack. i'll watch logs and traces for 30m. attached quick correlation script I used: ```python3 scripts/canary_check.py --rollout abc123 --since -10m```

alice: INCIDENT INC-2750004 -> mitigated -> moving to monitoring. please open postmortem and link CR-1248. owner: raj. ETA draft: EOD today.

incident-bot: NOTE: follow-up tasks created: TSK-6721 (postmortem INC-2750004), TSK-6722 (add automated kill-switch if >5% 5xx for 5m), TSK-6723 (stress test for kernel-quant toggles).

maria: quick RCA hypothesis: kernel selection + kv-cache behavior caused memory pressure under specific sequence-length distribution. reproducing locally now.

alice: thanks all. handing off monitoring to raj/kevin. if anything resurfaces, page primary oncall.

kevin: ack. monitoring window started. ping me if anything pops.
